Effective line: A cavernous reception. A single sign reads: ALL THINGS REQUIRE AUTHORIZATION. THIS INCLUDES THE SIGN.
Suggested line: A cavernous reception hall under a single sign: ALL THINGS REQUIRE AUTHORIZATION. THIS INCLUDES THE SIGN.

Effective line: Gerald in the breakroom is 4,000,212. You two will be neighbours. He's a lovely man. He's been there a while.
Suggested line: Gerald in the breakroom is 4,000,212, so you two will be neighbours. He's a lovely man, and he's been waiting a very long while.

Effective line: Agnes Overdue. Front desk, and on my lunch hour, appellant. Forty thousand appeals, every one denied. They've started decorating the stamps.
Suggested line: I'm Agnes Overdue. I work the front desk, and on my lunch hour I'm an appellant: forty thousand appeals, every one denied. They've started decorating the stamps.

Effective line: You are number 4,000,213. They are serving number 3. It is a very long queue, and it is the only way forward.
Suggested line: You are number 4,000,213 and they're serving number 3. It's a very long queue, and it's the only way forward.

Effective line: An intake clerk demands to see your paperwork. It is also a fight. It is mostly a fight.
Suggested line: An intake clerk demands to see your paperwork, and the inspection turns out to be mostly a fight.

Effective line: A small silvery ghost waves from the queue, the ribboned stack of appeals under one arm. "Number 4,000,213. Saved your place, dear. Nobody noticed. Nobody ever does.
Suggested line: A small silvery ghost waves from the queue, the ribboned stack of appeals under one arm. "Number 4,000,213. I saved your place, dear. Nobody noticed, but then nobody ever does.

Effective line: Gerald in the breakroom is 4,000,212. You two will be neighbours. He's a lovely man. He's been there a while.
Suggested line: Gerald in the breakroom is 4,000,212, so you two will be neighbours. He's a lovely man, and he's been waiting a very long while.

Effective line: I come down here on my lunch hour to appeal. Appeal number forty thousand and one. Denied. I am starting to take it personally.
Suggested line: I spent my lunch hour on appeal forty thousand and one, and it came back denied with a very nice stamp. I'm starting to take it personally.

Effective line: A small grey machine offers you a ticket. The display above says NOW SERVING 3. Your number is 4,000,213. A polite ghost behind you coughs, then apologises for coughing.
Suggested line: A small grey machine offers you ticket 4,000,213 while the display above says NOW SERVING 3. A polite ghost behind you coughs, then apologises for coughing.

Effective line: You wait. You wait some more. You feel seen, and slightly worse. A vending machine dispenses one sad cookie.
Suggested line: You wait, and then you wait some more, until a vending machine takes pity on you and dispenses one sad cookie.

Effective line: Nobody dares object. Yet. Number 4,000,213 is quietly becoming a legend.
Suggested line: Nobody dares object, at least not yet, and somewhere down the queue they have started whispering about Number 4,000,213.

Effective line: A very comfortable waiting room. The magazines are 600 years old. Restore HP.
Suggested line: A very comfortable waiting room, whose magazines are 600 years old. Restore HP.

Effective line: Every important document in the Hall is stamped, signed and witnessed here. The transfer of authority was, too. The notary is still finding blue-green feathers.
Suggested line: Every important document in the Hall is stamped, signed and witnessed here, the transfer of authority included. The notary is still finding blue-green feathers.

Effective line: Row after row of chairs. Can your deck outwait the line?
Suggested line: Row after row of chairs stretches into the distance. Can your deck outwait the line?

Effective line: The clock is lying. The clock was told to.
Suggested line: The clock is lying, and from the look of it, somebody ordered it to.

Effective line: It is flawless. Submitted, reviewed, approved, notarized, filed.
Suggested line: It's flawless: submitted, reviewed, approved, notarized and filed, without a single box left empty.

Effective line: Someone should look into it, dear. This form does not tell us what happened to the boy."
Suggested line: Someone should look into it, dear, because this form doesn't tell us what happened to the boy."

Effective line: Signed. Witnessed. Notarized. In triplicate. One copy is for you. You may not keep it.
Suggested line: Signed, witnessed and notarized in triplicate. One copy is for you, but you may not keep it.

Effective line: Two aisles over, Agnes is filling in a form with a very stubby pencil. "Form 27-C. Third attempt. It needs a 27-B, which needs a 27-C.
Suggested line: Two aisles over, Agnes is filling in a form with a very stubby pencil. "Form 27-C, third attempt. It needs a 27-B, which needs a 27-C.

Effective line: They keep stamping it DENIED. Irregular, apparently. Do not mind me, dear. I have filed worse and kept the receipts."
Suggested line: They keep stamping it DENIED and writing Irregular in the margin. Don't mind me, dear. I've filed worse and kept the receipts."

Effective line: Every form here has a twin. Every twin has a twin. The clerks are undead and, understandably, a bit short.
Suggested line: Every form here has a twin, and every twin has a twin of its own. The clerks are undead and, understandably, a bit short.

Effective line: It works! Mostly. Something in the ceiling disapproves, loudly, with a stapler.
Suggested line: It works, mostly. Something in the ceiling disapproves loudly, with a stapler.

Effective line: Nothing is left of Number 4,000,213. You feel lighter, and slightly nonexistent. The machine files you under 'Resolved.'
Suggested line: Nothing is left of Number 4,000,213. You feel lighter and slightly nonexistent as the machine files you under 'Resolved.'

Effective line: You pull out half of a lost appeal. It is, technically, a weapon. The machine takes a bite of you in exchange.
Suggested line: You pull out half of a lost appeal, which is technically a weapon, and the machine takes a bite of you in exchange.

Effective line: Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No, looks up from an infinite pile of paperwork. His face is as smooth as a blank form. His stamp is the size of a tombstone.
Suggested line: Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No, looks up from an endless pile of paperwork, his face as smooth as a blank form and his stamp the size of a tombstone.

Effective line: The answer is no. The question is irrelevant. Please state your case anyway.
Suggested line: The answer is no. The question is irrelevant, but you may state your case anyway.

Effective line: The answer is no. The question is irrelevant. Please state your case anyway.
Suggested line: The answer is no. The question is irrelevant, but you may state your case anyway.

Effective line: You wait. And wait. A clerk takes pity, and the polite ghost ahead of you shares a biscuit and apologises that it is stale.
Suggested line: You wait for a very long time, until a clerk takes pity and the polite ghost ahead of you shares a biscuit, apologising that it's stale.

Effective line: The Expedite Fee is an official fee, with an official receipt. A tiny clerk stamps your ticket and a door opens. You feel oddly refreshed.
Suggested line: The Expedite Fee is an official fee with an official receipt. A tiny clerk stamps your ticket, a door opens, and you feel oddly refreshed.

Effective line: You cut in line. Forty thousand undead clerks turn and glare. You are processed immediately, and a little roughly.
Suggested line: You cut in line, and forty thousand undead clerks turn to glare. You're processed immediately, and a little roughly.

Effective line: She does not look the other way. She looks at the gold. The gold is accepted.
Suggested line: She doesn't look the other way. She looks at the gold, and the gold is accepted.

Effective line: Please do not worry. Blood is optional. The signature is not."
Suggested line: Please don't worry, the blood is optional. The signature is not."

Effective line: You argue. A tiny stamp appears from nowhere and hits you. It hurts a little.
Suggested line: You argue until a tiny stamp appears from nowhere and hits you, which hurts a little.

Effective line: The authorization was valid. It was always valid. But the office is vacant, and policy is policy."
Suggested line: The authorization was valid, and it was always valid. But the office is now vacant, and policy is policy."

Effective line: The CE-No has been removed from office. By policy, the vacancy passes to the senior-most applicant on file. One moment. I will look it up.
Suggested line: The CE-No has been removed from office, and by policy the vacancy passes to the senior-most applicant on file. One moment while I look it up.

Effective line: ...It is a ghost. It is, for the record, you, Ms. Overdue.
Suggested line: ...The senior-most applicant is a ghost. It is, for the record, you, Ms. Overdue.

Effective line: The procedure is clear. The office passes to you, and I am afraid you cannot appeal it. I would have to deny it.
Suggested line: The procedure is clear: the office passes to you. You cannot appeal it, Ms. Overdue. I would only have to deny it, and I find I do not want to.

Effective line: ...Then I will stay, Mortimer. Not for you. I will stay until nobody waits as long as I did.
Suggested line: ...Then I'll stay, Mortimer, though not for you. I'll stay until nobody has to wait as long as I did.

Effective line: Even the dead deserve humanity. Our job is to help the lost souls. We have an obligation to help.
Suggested line: Everyone in that queue was somebody, and the dead deserve to be treated as people. Helping the lost is the whole job. It always was.

Effective line: Following orders be damned. We treat everyone with respect.
Suggested line: No order outranks that, Mortimer, not his and not yours. From today we treat everyone with respect.

Effective line: ...That is not in the handbook.
Suggested line: ...That is not in the handbook. I find myself wondering why it never was.

Effective line: Then we write a new one. Take a number, Mortimer. You are right behind Gerald.
Suggested line: Then we'll write a new one. Take a number and wait with the others, Mortimer. You're right behind Gerald, and he'll show you how it's done.

Effective line: the queue moved. like, actually moved. agnes called my number at 3am. i was afk. she called it again. nobody's ever called me twice.
Suggested line: the queue moved. it actually moved. agnes called my number at 3am and i was away from my desk, so she called it again. nobody's ever called me twice.

Effective line: anyway. wanna play? one more round before i pass on. jk. unless?
Suggested line: wanna play one more round before i pass on? kidding. probably.

Effective line: Back again. The ethics questions have been returned to the building. Not yet to the exam. One reform at a time.
Suggested line: Back again, I see. The ethics questions have been returned to the building, though not yet to the exam. One reform at a time.

Effective line: Statistically, you will still fail a question. Statistically, I will still enjoy it. Some things are not corruption. They are personality.
Suggested line: Statistically, you will still fail a question, and statistically I will still enjoy it. That is not corruption. That is personality.

Effective line: Leaving the D.N.A. ends this visit. Town heals you fully. You no longer need an exit permit. Nobody does. We are still a little scared of the pen.
Suggested line: Leaving the D.N.A. ends this visit. Town heals you fully, and you no longer need an exit permit. Nobody does, though we're all still a little scared of the pen.

Effective line: Head of the whole Department, and still on the front desk. They gave me a big office, dear. Nobody waits in a big office. They wait here.
Suggested line: I'm head of the whole Department now, and I'm still on the front desk. They gave me a big office, dear, but nobody waits in a big office. They wait here.

Effective line: Mortimer is in the Waiting Room, number 4,000,214. He is learning to wait. It is going about as well as you would expect.
Suggested line: Mortimer's in the Waiting Room as number 4,000,214, learning to wait. It's going about as well as you'd expect.

Effective line: The authorization is still valid. But there is a rule above it now: help people.
Suggested line: The authorization is still valid, dear, but there's a rule above it now: everyone who comes through that door is treated as a person.

Effective line: Prudence is my deputy. She is much nicer than she used to be, and so, I hear, am I.
Suggested line: Prudence is my deputy. She's much nicer than she used to be, and so, I'm told, am I.

Effective line: Oh! It's you! Gerald, barista, and as of this morning, Number 4,000,212: CALLED. I didn't know what to do with my hands. So I made coffee.
Suggested line: Oh, it's you! Gerald, barista, and as of this morning Number 4,000,212: CALLED. I didn't know what to do with my hands, so I made coffee.

Effective line: Cream? None. Sugar? None. Hope? Back in stock. I am trying not to use it all at once.
Suggested line: No cream and no sugar, I'm afraid. None at all. But hope's back in stock, and I'm trying not to use it all at once.

Effective line: Mortimer is Number 4,000,214 now. You were 213, in between us. Don't mention it to him. He goes very quiet.
Suggested line: Mortimer's Number 4,000,214 now, and you were 213, right between us. Don't mention it to him, though. He goes very quiet.

Effective line: Requisitions. Clerk Ledgerbone. The stamp has stopped haunting. It got its raise.
Suggested line: Clerk Ledgerbone, Requisitions. The stamp has stopped haunting the place now that it got its raise.

Effective line: It doesn't know what to do with itself. Neither do I. Cards, in triplicate, as always.
Suggested line: It doesn't know what to do with itself, and neither do I. Cards, in triplicate, as always.

Effective line: Practising. Just stood here for a minute. Nothing was filed. Exhilarating.
Suggested line: I've been practising. I just stood here for a whole minute and filed nothing at all. It was exhilarating.

Effective line: I only wanted to leave. I will. Soon. But first I'm fixing this place, so nobody else waits as long as I did.
Suggested line: I only ever wanted to leave, and I will, soon. But first I'm putting this place right, so nobody else waits as long as I did.

Effective line: Even the dead deserve humanity. Our job is to help the lost souls. Following orders be damned: we treat everyone with respect.
Suggested line: Everyone in that queue was somebody, dear, and the dead deserve to be treated as people. No order outranks that, not his and not anyone's.

Effective line: Mortimer Grimsby. Formerly CE-No. Currently number 4,000,214 in the Waiting Room of Eternity. Gerald was 4,000,212.
Suggested line: Mortimer Grimsby, formerly CE-No, currently number 4,000,214 in the Waiting Room of Eternity. Gerald was 4,000,212, and he has been very patient with me.

Effective line: You had 4,000,213. You did not wait. I keep thinking about that.
Suggested line: You had 4,000,213, and you did not wait. I keep thinking about that.

Effective line: I made others wait far longer. It is worse knowing that now.
Suggested line: I made others wait far longer than you, and every one of them was a person. It is worse, knowing that now.

Effective line: Intake's moving again! Agnes waved me straight through. First time in ten years nobody asked me for Form 27-B. Heh.
Suggested line: Intake's moving again! Agnes waved me straight through. First time in ten years nobody's asked me for Form 27-B, and my appointment book is filling up nicely.
